subject.title: Gemini models output inline buttons as raw JSON text instead of using tool format

question: Should OpenClaw support raw bracketed button JSON in model final text as a fallback for Gemini, or require Gemini/provider prompting to emit typed message-tool presentation buttons only?
rationale: Source inspection proves the structured-only gap, but accepting a raw final-text parser changes the model-output contract and affects transcript and Telegram delivery semantics.

options.title: Accept A Narrow Raw Fallback
options.body: Allow a constrained parser only after the linked PR or replacement is rebased, transcript-safe, and backed by redacted live Telegram/Gemini proof.

options.title: Retarget To Typed Routing
options.body: Reject raw final-text parsing and keep the fix focused on provider or prompt changes that make Gemini use structured message-tool buttons.

options.title: Wait For Live Repro First
options.body: Keep the issue open but defer implementation acceptance until a maintainer or reporter supplies a live Gemini/Telegram reproduction.

recommendation.title: Accept A Narrow Raw Fallback
recommendation.body: Allow a constrained parser only after the linked PR or replacement is rebased, transcript-safe, and backed by redacted live Telegram/Gemini proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses Telegram inline controls, reply routing, and product contract boundaries, and the linked candidate PR requests review from steipete.
